name: guido-dividend-system
description: Guido Dividend System - sistema local de inteligencia patrimonial, dividendos, B3 Ledger e FIIs.

scripts.check:structure: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const index=fs.readFileSync('public/index.html','utf8'); const dash=fs.readFileSync('public/dashboard.html','utf8'); const admin=fs.readFileSync('public/admin.html','utf8'); const engine=fs.readFileSync('public/financial-engine.js','utf8'); if(!index.includes('Radar de Proventos') || !index.includes('dashboard.html#sistema') || !dash.includes('quantEngine') || !admin.includes('unitEconomics') || !engine.includes('GDSFinancialEngine')) process.exit(1); console.log('OK: entrada, dashboard, admin e motor financeiro encontrados');"
scripts.check: npm run check:structure && npm run test:finance
scripts.admin:migrate: cd workers/admin-api && npx wrangler d1 migrations apply radar-admin-finops --remote
